product_metadata.title: Vtopmart 3 Tier Rolling Cart with Wheels, Detachable Utility Storage Cart with Handle and Lockable Casters, Heavy Duty Storage Basket Organizer Shelves, Easy Assemble for Office, Bathroom, Kitchen
features: Convience Design: Equipped with 4 wheels(2 lockable) and handle. Unlock it when you want to move it and lock it when you want to fix in one place, and you don't have to worry about it being hard to move.
Make Storage Easier: Vtopmart 3-Tier Utility Cart is a good helper for home organized and saving space. It measures 15"L x 11.6"W x 30.7"H,which is compact for room organization and storage.

Save Space: It covers most of your needs. Even though it is a narrow space, our organizer cart has 3 large capacity storage baskets to make sure you can hold a lot of things. Also, it is detachable that allows it not just to be put on the floor, but on the table as well.

Multifunctional Use: This lash cart can be widely used in any situation, like kitchen, living room, bathroom,bedroom, storage room. It can hold a lot of things, like spice bottle, towels, books, albums. Or you can also use it as a mobile food cart, a mobile wine cart at a party.
Easy to Install: Just point the pipe at the hole and fit it in, no skill is required, and no screws or tools are needed. And done, just use it! It is quick and easy.
